title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier with Towel Bar Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage with a wall mount glass shelf built with three tiers and an integrated towel bar. Sized 16 x 5 inches, this traditional bathroom hardware piece uses solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass for strength and everyday confidence.

Highlights:
- Triple-tier glass shelf organizer for toiletries, bottles, and décor
- Integrated towel bar provides a convenient towel rail for hand towels
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges
- Solid brass hardware construction
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, heritage bathroom fixtures look

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16-inch L x 5-inch W x 18-inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Offered in multiple finishes, including statement colors

One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
